the construction
The vertices come in four pairs, the black, blue, red and green rods. Each rod is horizontal with its midpoint on the vertical axis (dashed), so the half-turn about the axis is a symmetry. The black rod 2-7 is fixed at height 0 with half-length ½. The sliders place the blue and the red rod.
